name: What De Health Thai
notes: 3 photos of a two-page printed menu. Photos 1 and 3 are the same page 1 (starters/salad/soup/house specials) at different crops, merged. Photo 2 is page 2 (noodles/fried rice/curries/stir fried/sweet treats); curries, stir fried, noodles and fried rice have no per-dish price printed (price follows a shared protein-choice table), so price was omitted for those.

dishes.name: Fresh Rolls
dishes.description: Organic lettuce leaves, carrots, cucumber, and pea shoots, wrapped in rice paper, served with peanut sauce and plum sauce (vegetarian); tofu $8.95 or shrimp $9.95

dishes.name: Mieng Kham
dishes.description: Traditional Thai snack: organic lacinato kale leaves filled with roasted chickpeas, coconut, diced lime, diced ginger, diced red onion, served with lemongrass sauce; tofu or shrimp $8.95

dishes.name: Thai Dumplings
dishes.description: Steamed dumplings stuffed with carrots and green onion, served with house-made dipping sauce; shrimp or chicken

dishes.name: Satay

dishes.name: Cheesy Stuffed
dishes.description: Fried wontons stuffed with cream cheese and herbs, served with plum sauce

dishes.name: Crispy Rolls

dishes.name: Garlic Edamame
dishes.description: Seasoned edamame tossed with fried garlic

dishes.name: Pot Sticker

dishes.name: Thai Salad
